title: ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. translated_title: ActICL：面向智能体多模态上下文学习的后训练方法
translated_abstract: 多模态上下文学习（ICL）是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的一项重要能力，其性能与所使用的演示示例密切相关，因此演示检索成为ICL的核心问题。常见方法使用固定的评分方式一次性检索全部演示示例，这可能引入冗余和噪声。上下文感知检索方法为解决这一问题而出现，允许从不断增长的上下文中进行增量检索。然而，现有方法都无法让MLLM学会自主判断需要哪些新演示示例，并据此自行开展渐进式检索。为此，我们提出了ActICL，它通过工具增强推理训练MLLM智能体来获取和使用ICL上下文。ActICL智能体在迭代推理和工具使用过程中分析自身的信息缺口，基于这些缺口执行有针对性的检索以获取一组初始候选演示示例，随后它可以……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ActICL通过后训练使多模态大模型智能体在迭代推理中自主分析信息缺口，并借助工具增强推理进行渐进式的针对性演示检索，从而自主构建多模态上下文学习所需的上下文。
en_tdlr: ActICL post-trains an MLLM agent to autonomously identify its information gaps during iterative tool-augmented reasoning and progressively perform targeted demonstration retrieval, building the ICL context on its own.
